title: Rhythm Cartography
pageTitle: Rhythm Cartography: 50 years of electronic music, mapped and playable
ogTitle: Rhythm Cartography: 50 years of electronic music, mapped and playable
description: 33 electronic genres, from dub (1973) to phonk. Tap a genre to play its rhythm, hear its iconic instrument and melody, compare grooves, and download them as MIDI.
cardText: An interactive map of 33 electronic music genres, from the 1970s to today. Every genre plays its own rhythm, instrument and melody, live in your browser. You can download any groove as MIDI.
imageAlt: Rhythm Cartography: a timeline map of electronic music genres next to a playable 16-step rhythm grid
